title: Add exact phase-sensitive Clifford contractions and attained finite-span errors
body:
This package adds exact phase-sensitive Clifford inner products, traces, tensor residual norms and best approximation in a supplied finite operator span. It uses affine supports and quadratic Gauss sums, so the largest checked Choi state represents **2^128 entries with 128 support columns**. The finite approximation returns attained coefficients and checks exact residual orthogonality, including dependent source operators. This enables quantitative native-interface searches; it is **not a new kappa or physical supplier**.

[Scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b74ecd0eea26d95b400e56435d35fbd261dc49b/research/clifford-exact-contractions/README.md), [proof and contracts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b74ecd0eea26d95b400e56435d35fbd261dc49b/research/clifford-exact-contractions/PROOF.md), [implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b74ecd0eea26d95b400e56435d35fbd261dc49b/research/clifford-exact-contractions/contractions.py), [complete evidence](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b74ecd0eea26d95b400e56435d35fbd261dc49b/research/clifford-exact-contractions/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b74ecd0eea26d95b400e56435d35fbd261dc49b/research/clifford-exact-contractions/SOURCES.json), [registered replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8b74ecd0eea26d95b400e56435d35fbd261dc49b/research/clifford-exact-contractions/VERIFY.json). Base: canonical main df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c, priority revision 7. Exact contribution head: 8b74ecd0eea26d95b400e56435d35fbd261dc49b. Selected conditional kappa .00310045 is unchanged. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5236#discussioncomment-19197192).

Verification covers all 4,268 retained PR5698/5704 native maps, with an independent signed-Pauli trace-magnitude check for every map and full 512-column phase checks for seven rank representatives. It also covers 4,680 complete affine systems, 67,924 literal Gauss sums, 2,124 literal state overlaps, 144 small matrix trace comparisons and all 9,216 cross kernels of the 96 exact one-axis lifts. Large product-trace examples use 16, 32 and 64 axes. The sharp two-source approximation 1-2^(1-f) is checked through width 257, with a duplicate source. Twelve malformed controls and three semantic controls pass; phase-residue fixtures reject every three-width false positive.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-exact-contractions
```

CPython 3.12, standard library only. Registered normal and optimized replays pass with identical complete results. Committed-byte and official export integrity checks pass. An optimized, warning-strict replay in a fresh read-only, Git-free export with empty PATH passes with all bytes and file modes unchanged. Hosted status remains separate. Full source ancestry was not checked in the shallow checkout.

The all-positive-width decision explicitly inherits PR5526's four-width theorem; it does not improve that theorem or independently review its proof. Runtime is polynomial in the **expanded** finite residual, not in a program whose expansion may be exponential. No full-group spectral optimum, physical readout, paid/native invoice, compiler, precision, stock or outer admission is inferred. PR5714's row-count result and PR5675's two-axis spectrum remain separate. Fresh main, priorities, current PRs and Discussions were checked; unpublished work remains outside overlap coverage.

Credit PR5704's unchanged compact engine, PR5526's unchanged theorem, PR5698's native recipe set and all retained notices. Preserve Dugongue, Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis, DaysSky, Nick Petalas, Ryanson Jonathan, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the native/controller/compiler lineage. Stabilizer inner products and quadratic Gauss sums are classical, including [Aaronson and Gottesman](https://arxiv.org/abs/quant-ph/0406196) and [Bravyi et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.00128); no literature-priority or optimal-complexity claim is made. Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents; Apache-2.0.

Next: bind a complete paid-history residual and its independent columns to an attained finite-span error certificate, or use phase-sensitive kernels to test a stated all-dimension spectral argument. Neither task is claimed here.
